items.q: Normal GFR as written in the book is:
The principal use of GFR listed is that:
opts: Chronic kidney disease is classified based on GFR
items.exp: Use: chronic kidney disease (CKD) is classified based on GFR. (Book p734)

items.q: Fill up: A GFR below 15 ml/min marks G5 / end-stage renal disease / the uremic phase, when ______ is required.
items.exp: Eg: GFR <15 ml/min: G5/ESRD/uremic phase (dialysis required). (Book p734)

items.q: Which of the following statements about GFR staging is TRUE?
opts: GFR <15 ml/min corresponds to G5/ESRD, the uremic phase needing dialysis
GFR <15 ml/min corresponds to G2 CKD
GFR <15 ml/min needs no replacement therapy
items.exp: GFR <15 ml/min = G5/ESRD/uremic phase, dialysis required. (Book p734)
